comparison.objective: Set a sink drain’s slope within a code window while supported on three stands.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and adjust a long drain to a specified inclination; no impact fracture, recessed mandrel alignment, or fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Required slope window and bearing on all stands; detailed numeric scoring is absent from the record body.
comparison.reason: It tests supported geometric adjustment, meaningfully different from contact-driven HELICOIL tang fracture and containment.
